name: commuter-cave
description: A survival-and-invention game prototype: procedural worlds, field notes, process network, crafting model, real geography.

scripts.world: node src/cli.js generate --seed pig-rock --preset temperate-woodland --out out
scripts.network: node src/cli.js network --seed pig-rock --preset temperate-woodland --out out
scripts.test:player: node tools/timed.mjs test:player -- "node build.mjs" "node tests/ui/scripted-player.cjs pig-rock temperate-woodland"
scripts.test:ui: node tools/timed.mjs test:ui -- "node build.mjs" "node tests/ui/here-actions.cjs" "node tests/ui/focus-search.cjs" "node tests/ui/plans.cjs" "node tests/ui/drill-diagnosis.cjs" "node tests/ui/scan-report.cjs m" "node tests/ui/poke-around.cjs pig-rock" "node tests/ui/mental-map.cjs c" "node tests/ui/replay.cjs pig-rock" "node tests/ui/water-milestone.cjs" "node tests/ui/quick.cjs" "node tests/ui/map-shape.cjs"
scripts.test:sim: node tools/timed.mjs test:sim -- "node tests/sim/anchors.mjs" "node tests/sim/fire-across-worlds.mjs" "node tests/sim/geo-spawn.mjs" "node tests/sim/outlook.mjs" "node tests/sim/smell.mjs" "node tests/sim/walk-traps.mjs" "node tests/sim/food-prep.mjs"
scripts.test: node tools/timed.mjs test -- "npm run --silent test:sim" "npm run --silent test:ui"
scripts.test:quick: node tools/timed.mjs test:quick -- "node build.mjs" "QUICK=1 node tests/sim/anchors.mjs" "QUICK=1 node tests/sim/fire-across-worlds.mjs" "QUICK=1 node tests/sim/geo-spawn.mjs" "QUICK=1 node tests/sim/outlook.mjs" "QUICK=1 node tests/sim/smell.mjs" "QUICK=1 node tests/sim/walk-traps.mjs" "QUICK=1 node tests/sim/food-prep.mjs" "node tests/ui/quick.cjs"
scripts.test:soak: node tools/timed.mjs test:soak -- "node build.mjs" "node tests/ui/smoke.cjs" "node tests/ui/scripted-player.cjs pig-rock temperate-woodland"
